# NeuromorphicSpiking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Event-driven, time-based spiking neural activity emulated in neuromorphic hardware for energy-efficient computation. Serves as the core computational primitive for iNEST systems and informs hardware prototyping from biological circuits.
